project_type: Two repositories, worked on together. (1) /root/apis/mussannoni - a Python package plus a PDF fidelity workshop. The workshop measures 46 immutable SARS reference PDFs into templates/<level>/<report>/fixture.json (full placed geometry) and mussannoni.render_document() reproduces them; the package distils each fixture to src/mussannoni/resources/<level>/<report>/layout.json and mussannoni.render_report(key, data) places caller rows onto it. Both paths converge on the same render_document + template.html + engines. (2) /root/apis/backend-sis - the FastAPI ExaMetrics backend that installs the package, resolves rows from its own tables, and uploads the resulting PDFs to R2.
language: Python 3.11 in the mussannoni repo (.python-version pins 3.11; requires-python >=3.11,<3.14). Python 3.12 in backend-sis (venv at backend-sis/venv).
build_system: mussannoni: uv (pyproject.toml + uv.lock) with a Makefile wrapping the canonical commands; hatchling builds the wheel/sdist from the src/ layout. backend-sis: pip + requirements.txt into backend-sis/venv. No compiled build step in either.
test_framework: mussannoni: pytest 9.1.1 via `uv run pytest` (== `make test`); tests/ holds test_package.py, test_templates.py, test_fidelity.py, test_catalog.py, test_evidence.py, test_engine.py. pyproject sets addopts=-q, testpaths=[tests], pythonpath=[.]. backend-sis: pytest exists but AGENTS.md records the existing suite as outdated and explicitly not a quality gate - verify backend behaviour by importing modules and calling functions directly.
build_command: uv sync (mussannoni). There is NO frontend build in this task and `npm run build` is forbidden outright.
test_command: cd /root/apis/mussannoni && uv run pytest   (lint: uv run ruff check .   combined: make check, which also runs check-resources)
verification_instructions: 1) In mussannoni: `uv sync`, then `make doctor` should print 'environment ready' (pdftoppm + agent-browser + the licensed Arial/Times faces). Fidelity metrics are only comparable to committed values when doctor is green. 2) Regenerate packaged resources after ANY change under templates/ or to tools/package_resources.py: `make package-resources`; assert no drift with `make check-resources`. 3) Render one report through the package API in-process: /root/apis/mussannoni/.venv/bin/python -c "import mussannoni; open('/tmp/x.pdf','wb').write(mussannoni.render_report('school_results', {'rows': [...]}, level='secondary'))". 4) Inspect the result with pymupdf (page_count, page rect, per-page get_text) - NOT with the deprecated `import fitz` alias. 5) Verify the backend by importing directly with /root/apis/backend-sis/venv/bin/python3 and calling app.services.exametrics.mussannoni.service functions; never over HTTP. 6) Workshop-side fidelity for a single report: `make convert-one LEVEL=secondary REPORT=school_results` (long-running; rewrites committed artifacts).
snapshot_or_generated_files: GENERATED AND COMMITTED in mussannoni: src/mussannoni/resources/** (template.html, reports.json, _shared/, <level>/<report>/{report.css,fonts/,layout.json}) regenerated by `make package-resources` and drift-checked by `make check-resources` and tests/test_package.py::test_packaged_resources_are_current; output/<level>/<key>/{rendered.pdf,report.json,diff-page-NN.png} regenerated by tools.render + tools.compare; templates/<level>/<key>/{fixture.json,report.css,calibration.json,bindings.yaml} generated by scaffold/tune; the README conversion-status table between the <!-- conversion-status:start/end --> markers generated by tools/status.py. corpus/ is READ-ONLY and must never be edited. work/ is gitignored scratch.
setup_instructions: cd /root/apis/mussannoni && uv sync. A .venv already exists at /root/apis/mussannoni/.venv. The package is already installed into the backend venv as mussannoni 0.1.0, so backend-sis picks up src/ changes only after reinstalling; check with /root/apis/backend-sis/venv/bin/python3 -c "import mussannoni, pathlib; print(pathlib.Path(mussannoni.__file__).resolve())" before assuming a package edit is visible to the backend.
environment_constraints: HARD PROHIBITIONS from /root/apis/AGENTS.md, all of which apply to every feature in this task: NEVER run `npm run build` or any next build; NEVER restart a service (supervisorctl / pm2 / systemctl); NEVER run `alembic upgrade head`; NEVER execute raw DDL by any route including inside a rolled-back transaction; NEVER query information_schema or pg_catalog - read the SQLAlchemy models in app/db/models/ instead; NEVER call the backend API with curl/httpie (no credentials are available) - import and call functions directly. Use the venvs, never system python: /root/apis/mussannoni/.venv/bin/python and /root/apis/backend-sis/venv/bin/python3. All imports go at the top of the module, never inline. No new Swahili in code, plans or docs - the Swahili in the primary report content is the reference's own and stays. Leave no scratch files in /root/apis or either repo; use /tmp and clean up. `import fitz` is deprecated in this codebase; use `import pymupdf`. This task performs NO production change: no commit, no deploy, no restart.
contribution_requirements: Fidelity gates in docs/01-fidelity.md are never relaxed (per page SSIM >= 0.98, differing pixels <= 0.5% at 300 dpi, text drift <= 1.0pt, column-edge drift <= 0.5pt, text_content_equal, page count/size/orientation equal), and neither are the THRESHOLDS in tools/compare.py or tests/test_fidelity.py. corpus/ is immutable. Templates carry no literal sample values (enforced by tests/test_templates.py). Everything is measured, never hand-typed. Additive schema changes must keep the committed resources regenerable and drift-free. The backend deletions in FEAT-006 must not change any field the frontend reads.
key_patterns: PACKAGE: src/mussannoni/api.py (render_report/report_layout) -> registry.py (find/list_reports over resources/reports.json) -> resources.py (packaged-path resolution via importlib.resources, asset_uris) -> table.py::build_document (places caller rows onto layout.json; _normalise_rows, _body_cell, _synthesise_rules, _apply_header_overrides, _rewrite_cell_text, _apply_loose_overrides, _fallback_prototype, _label_row_index) -> document.py::render_document (validates a geometry document, Jinja-renders template.html, dispatches to engines.py, then optimize.py). document.py ALREADY validates per-page `columns`, so per-page grids need no renderer change. WORKSHOP: tools/package_resources.py::distil_layout is the bridge (_body_prototype takes the modal cell shape and SKIPS spanning cells; _rows_per_page divides the tallest measured band by the row height; _column_labels reads the busiest header row; _hairline keeps header rule segments verbatim and the body's are redrawn by table.py::_synthesise_rules; _transplanted_header + _remap_row + _is_label_row handle a compound first page). BACKEND: app/services/exametrics/mussannoni/{service,catalog,resolve,context,data,bindings,headers,artifacts}.py; service.generate_exam builds context once, plans units, then per unit resolves canonical rows, remaps them to binding columns, builds header/loose overrides, renders and uploads. Enqueued by app/tasks/exametrics.py after results processing; a failure to enqueue only logs a warning, so missing artifacts is a normal failure mode.
directory_structure: mussannoni: tools/ (workshop pipeline), templates/{_shared,<level>/<key>}/ (measured product incl. fixture.json, bindings.yaml, calibration.json), corpus/ (46 read-only reference PDFs + MANIFEST.json), extract/ (measurement evidence), output/<level>/<key>/ (committed rendered.pdf + report.json + diff PNGs), src/mussannoni/ (the package) with src/mussannoni/resources/ (generated, committed), catalog/reports.yaml (46 entries + status), docs/00-05, tests/, .agents/tasks/ (this convention), .kiro/steering/. Directory names use dashes; report_key uses underscores. backend-sis: app/services/exametrics/mussannoni/ (the integration), app/api/exametrics/v1/mussannoni.py (route), app/db/models/exametrics/mussannoni_artifact.py (model), app/tasks/exametrics.py (enqueue). frontend-sis: lib/api/mussannoni.ts and components/exametrics/mussannoni-reports.tsx only list and download pre-generated artifacts; it never renders.

measured_defects.bands_dropped: 3 of 46 reports have a compound first page (page-1 column count differs from the modal/body count) and lose every band between the letterhead and the label row. secondary/school-results: page1 11 cols vs body 9, label row index 6, 5 rows dropped - fixture page-1 rows 1-4 are the SEX x I/II/III/IV/0 division summary with F/M/T counts and row 5 is a spacer; the letterhead's own last line 'DIVISION PERFORMANCE SUMMARY' survives with nothing beneath it. primary/school-results: page1 25 cols vs body 23, label row index 14, 13 rows dropped - the A-E/ABS/JUMLA x WAV/WAS/JUMLA grade matrix, WASTANI WA SHULE 23.48, %PASS (A-D) / %FAIL (E), KUNDI LA UMAHILRI, NAFASI KIWILAYA 156/169, NAFASI KIMKOA 1039/1161 and a section heading. primary/region-ufaulu-masomo: page1 28 cols vs body 20, label row index 3, 2 rows dropped (a section heading and a spacer). The other 43 reports are single-grid and structurally unaffected by this defect.
measured_defects.no_measured_capacity: layout.json carries one rows_per_page, computed by _rows_per_page as tallest-measured-band // row_height. For secondary/school-results that yields 39. The reference's own page 1 carries 26 candidate rows (33 rows minus 7 front rows) and its continuation pages carry 36. Placing 39 puts the page-1 table bottom at table.y_pt 54.24 + header 111.05 + 39 x 12.72 = 661.37pt on a 612pt page, i.e. 49.37pt past the page box; only 35 fit, so a 44-row render produced 35 rows on page 1 and 9 on page 2 instead of the intended 39 + 5. The reference measured BOTH capacities and the deleted backend TemplateSpec modelled both as first_page_rows and rows_per_page with the explicit note that capacity is measured, never computed.
measured_defects.reference_content_as_default: src/mussannoni/resources/secondary/school-results/layout.json header row 0 ships the measured letterhead lines verbatim: "THE PRIME MINISTER'S OFFICE", "REGIONAL ADMINISTRATION AND LOCAL GOVERNMENT", "MWANZA REGION", "REGIONAL FORM TWO MOCK ASSESSMENT RESULTS, JULY 2026", "S0333 - MWANZA SECONDARY SCHOOL", "DIVISION PERFORMANCE SUMMARY". They carry no role annotation, so the only way to replace them is data['header'] keyed "row.col". docs/05-packaging.md excludes bindings.yaml and calibration.json as 'provenance'. Consequences in backend-sis: headers.py is 407 lines that re-derive the semantics with regexes (_AUTHORITY_PREFIXES, _EXAM_MARKERS, _REGION_SUFFIX/_REGION_PREFIX, classify_line, _is_figure, _figure_rows, unsafe_header_reason, header_carries_figures, summary_overrides) and hardcode SAMPLE_LOCATIONS = ("MWANZA CC","MWANZA") - duplicated verbatim in resolve.py; bindings.py is 1306 lines of hand-typed per-report column orders guarded by service.binding_matches_layout.
measured_defects.dead_positional_slots: Distillation collapses colspans into single columns and keeps the grid's empty edge columns as addressable slots. secondary/school-results layout labels are ['', 'CNO', 'CANDIDATE FULL NAME', 'SEX', 'AGGT', 'DIV', 'POS', 'DETAILED SUBJECTS', ''] - 9 slots for 7 data columns (fixture 11 cols collapsed: 45.5+78.7=124.2 and 29.3+402.27=431.57; the 26.4pt and 15.02pt edge columns survive). layout body.cells covers columns 1-7 only, so slots 0 and 8 have no measured prototype and table.py::_fallback_prototype would fabricate a cell shape for anything placed there. This is why the backend binding reads ['', 'student_id', ..., 'detailed_subjects', ''] and why a caller must pad rows with None at both ends.
measured_defects.band_cannot_be_remapped: The dropped bands cannot simply be moved onto the body grid, and _remap_row is right to refuse. For secondary/school-results the body grid's cumulative edges are {0, 26.4, 71.9, 196.1, 221.42, 246.77, 272.09, 297.41, 728.98, 744.0} while the summary band's cells break at 117.4 and 326.71, which are not edges of that grid. The band therefore needs its own column grid, carried per page - which document.py already supports.

design_source_to_converge_on: backend-sis HEAD c6fa6313, recoverable with `git -C /root/apis/backend-sis show HEAD:app/services/exametrics/mussannoni/template/spec.py`. TemplateSpec/Region/RowBand/TextRun/VecPath already modelled: head Region covering ALL page-1 bands; continuation_head taken from the reference's second page rather than assumed; first_page_rows AND rows_per_page both measured from the reference ('This is measured, not computed' - deriving capacity by dividing page height produced capacities below what the reference demonstrably fitted); first_page_band, first_page_spanning, first_page_span_top because page 1 was measured separately from the band carrying the slots; per-row row_offsets and row_paths so the reference's own rounding and its thicker header-separator rule are reproduced rather than approximated by stamping one sampled row; spanning column rules and tints emitted once per page and stretched to the row count; x_model, a per-run placement model fitted from the reference's own rows per character class (digits/dots/others) so centred and right-aligned columns land without needing font metrics; and named slots. render/paginate.py (62 lines) is the compact statement of the capacity rule. Do NOT invent a new vocabulary; express these concepts over the fixture's table model.
